card.title: Prove Your Loyalty
card.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

mechanism: A tests whether B will prioritize a hypothetical move and grades even a small availability concession without naming the test.
confusable: Unlike ordinary scheduling, A must treat practical responses as measures of personal worth.
comparison: D11-b disguises loyalty grading as planning; D11-a disguises preferential image ordering as readability.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
